objective_value: <float> Total transportation cost summed over all vehicles and all traversed edges, equal to edge distance times the linear weight-related cost evaluated at the vehicle's load weight.

routes.route: <list[int]> Ordered route using the formulation's duplicated depot nodes: start at depot.id (normally 0), visit customer IDs 1..num_customers, and end at the virtual depot entrance num_customers+1. The virtual entrance has the physical location and time window of the depot.
routes.deliveries: <dict, key: '{customer}'> Positive quantity delivered to each visited customer.

edges.from: <int> Origin node, including virtual entrance where applicable.
edges.to: <int> Destination node; the final edge ends at num_customers+1.
edges.load_weight: <float> Load carried on this edge before delivery at its destination.
